name: bKash, Rocket, Nagad Payment Gateway for WooCommerce – Secure Mobile Banking in Bangladesh
author: Yasir Arafat

sections.description:
This WooCommerce payment gateway plugin enables online store owners to accept bKash, Rocket, and Nagad payments in Bangladesh. It supports manual payment verification, transaction ID checking, and WooCommerce admin order integration. Ideal for businesses using mobile banking in Bangladesh.

Key Features:

  • Separate bKash, Rocket, and Nagad payment options in WooCommerce checkout.
  • Customizable account numbers, descriptions, and transaction instructions.
  • Manual transaction ID verification for secure processing.
  • Special handling for Mystery Box product orders.
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).
  • Payment details are visible in the WooCommerce admin order page.

License

sections.installation:
1. Download and upload the bKash, Rocket, Nagad WooCommerce Payment Gateway plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install directly via the WordPress Plugin Repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  4. Enable and configure the bKash, Rocket, and Nagad payment methods with your mobile banking account details.
  5. Save settings and start accepting payments.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support automatic payment verification?

No, this WooCommerce mobile banking payment gateway plugin processes bKash, Rocket, and Nagad transactions manually. Store owners must verify payments using the provided transaction ID.

Can I use this plugin outside Bangladesh?

Technically, yes, but it is designed for Bangladeshi mobile banking services like bKash, Rocket, and Nagad.

How do I add different payment numbers?

Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments, select bKash, Rocket, or Nagad, and update the account numbers in the settings.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest WooCommerce versions?

Yes, this plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce 8.1 and WordPress 6.8.
